note: Forecasts, not observations. Global models at 0.25° sampled on a 0.5° grid (about 55 km); anything finer on the map is drawn between samples, not forecast. Rainfall is the total of each 3-hour step. Probabilities are the share of the 51 ECMWF ensemble members over a threshold, not a calibrated certainty. No local calibration. For warnings, refer to the Myanmar Department of Meteorology and Hydrology.
projection: rows are spaced in Web Mercator so the image quad lands each cell where it belongs; columns are linear in longitude

wind.note: arrows point downwind; size by speed
